# ops_template_catalog (Resource)

The template catalog: a folder of JSON templates in a repository branch, one per installation; OPS loads each new commit. Destroying it disconnects the catalog: the templates come from TEMPLATES_DIR again.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The templates live in an Azure DevOps repository; the builder commits to it.
resource "ops_template_catalog" "this" {
  vcs_connection_id = ops_vcs_connection.ado.id
  repo              = "Infra/templates"
  branch            = "main"
  mode              = "commit"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repo` (String) `owner/repo` on GitHub, `project/repo` on Azure DevOps.
- `vcs_connection_id` (String) The VCS connection that reads it; with mode `commit` or `pr` one with write access.

### Optional

- `branch` (String)
- `dir` (String) The folder of the templates; empty: the root.
- `mode` (String) What saving a template in OPS's builder does: `off` (templates are edited in Git only), `commit` (to the branch) or `pr` (a pull request).

### Read-Only

- `commit` (String) The commit loaded.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `sync_error` (String) Why the last commit didn't load (an invalid template), if it didn't: the catalog keeps the templates it had.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# there is one catalog: any id
terraform import ops_template_catalog.this template-catalog
```
